blocks.text: NEW YORK — Actor Margaret Qualley and Grammy winner Jack Antonoff have filed for divorce after three years of marriage, according to court records. The case was filed Friday, Oct. 30, in Kings County Supreme Court in Brooklyn, New York, and is listed as an uncontested matrimonial action. Qualley is listed as the plaintiff, and Antonoff as the defendant. Attorneys for Qualley and Antonoff did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The couple separated in July.
